body.title: Verify complete publication across crashes and concurrent requests
body.summary: Integrate complete/incomplete ledgers, real canonical lifecycle store and completed sc4 fence with bounded crash/fault fixtures. Prove coverage, fresh ownership, canonical CAS, receipt replay and mode/legacy parity; export only the internal S5 composition boundary.
acceptanceChecks: All missing evidence/coverage/block cases and conflicting or non-independent inputs produce no successful canonical publication.
Real crash/lost-ACK tests around intent, canonical commit and terminal receipt converge to one operation/revision/receipt.
Concurrent completion and edited/newer heads cannot duplicate or overwrite canonical result; stale pins/owner between assessment and CAS refuse.
Identical source/index accepted state produces equal verdict and explicit impact limitations; pending usage never becomes invented coverage or tokens.
Focused completion/recovery/canonical-lifecycle/legacy compatibility suites and production build pass without live LLM or whole-repo sweep; one required code review after build.

tests.name: Completion crash concurrency and stale pin matrix converges to one canonical result
Complete blocked warned and incomplete review outcomes preserve mode and coverage semantics
Focused completion recovery canonical lifecycle compatibility suites and production build
